request.prompt:
Make a new complete 16:9 mechanical prop reference “北端洞闸·卸力后静止、仍封闭”. IMAGE 1 fixes connected stone body; IMAGE 2 fixes long timber; IMAGE 3 fixes inert snake body colour. FIRST keep the whole stone structure from IMAGE 1: south small barred feeding door, two broad flat covers, continuous low stone sides, north gate, rear covered short segment and rock. Widen blank background only. Raise/extend ONLY THE TOPS of both wooden posts AND the moving wooden panel, giving the upper wooden assembly ample height above the knee-high stone lids.
SECOND remove the original little through-post locking rod completely, including its two protruding round ends. Leave no pegs sticking out of either post. Do NOT draw circular holes on the long beam.
THIRD fix one SHORT horizontal cleat onto the FRONT surface of the MOVING panel, above stone-lid height; both ends stop WELL INSIDE the two posts.
FOURTH add the long grey-brown round beam from IMAGE 2 AGAINST THE FRONT FACE of the cleat. This long beam is CLOSEST TO THE VIEWER, IN FRONT OF BOTH posts. Draw its visible silhouette crossing over and HIDING the middle strips of both posts. At each intersection the LOG HIDES THE POST, NEVER the reverse. The log is uninterrupted from left tip to right tip; it never passes through a post hole.
FIFTH add exactly two short tight rope loops clamping the touching long beam and short cleat together at the moving panel centre, well away from the fixed posts. No hanging rope, no post bindings. Leave a visible gap between log and stone lid. South feeding door retains its FULL horizontal wooden bar. All roofed stone parts and rock remain connected.
After confirmation and gradual unloading, the panel remains still, with its bottom resting on the inert snake segment inside. It has NOT been confirmed fully at bottom and the locking pin has NOT been reinserted. The long timber is still bound to the moving cleat but has no hands, force arrows or external loads. It is in FRONT OF both posts, never threaded through them; its continuous foreground outline HIDES both posts at the crossing points.
A restrained small ghosted patch in the north roof/side reveals the panel resting on the snake, labelled “内部示意”. Keep continuous dotted outlines so this is explanatory, not a physical stone opening. No exposed severed ends or gore, no snake outside. Southern feeding door stays shut with original horizontal bar intact.
Keep whole stone body, rear roofed segment, rock and timber ends in frame. Clean grey/brown hand-painted flat rendering on pale ground, no inset needed, highest native resolution. Optional discreet caption “卸力后静止，未插栓”.
